title: Enhancing Stance Classification on Social Media Using Quantified Moral Foundations
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the stance (Favor, Against, None) towards the topic of 'Atheism'.
findings: The primary finding is that incorporating moral foundations enhances stance detection models' performance. This was demonstrated across various targets, including 'Atheism'. Figures in the paper visualize the different moral foundation biases associated with 'Favor', 'Against', and 'None' stances toward atheism, but the text does not offer specific interpretations of these findings, focusing instead on the methodological improvements.
